crossCaseConclusion: Both. Several plans omit material conditions, exceptions, or scope limits even when their sourceEvidence quotes those facts; a quote alone does not make preservation an instruction. Other cases block supported partial work by assuming the objective requires unavailable details, especially B022, C005, and C007. More explicit output fields or validation could catch omitted guards and unjustified blocking, but those checks also require sound interpretation of what the source actually supports. The first gold is contestable where it assumes a fully actionable answer despite missing release authority, customer availability, or an immediate alert protocol.
